# Harvest learnings

Read the [standard](../../../docs/standards/delivery.md) and
[learning register](../../../docs/delivery/learnings.md).
Record a concise observation, evidence, proposed improvement, owner and Pending status,
or state that no useful learning arose.

Separate product follow-up from workflow improvement. Suggestions do not become
instructions until approved and incorporated through a scoped change. Never apply
new policy, grant exceptions or modify upstream automatically.

If export is requested, prepare a sanitised proposal for human review; do not send
source, sensitive business details or personal information to another system.

Output: stage learning and optional explicitly requested feedback proposal.
